claims.quote: Three levels, from a free demo to attested due diligence.
claims.statement: The seller's offering is structured as three levels, ranging from a free demo to attested due diligence.
claims.tier_basis: The firm buys only the attested level and has said the demo and beta are of no commercial interest, so the shape and count of the other levels changes nothing in its plan. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: A claims review is priced by the size of the claim set and quoted after intake
claims.statement: A claims review is priced according to the size of the claim set, not by a fixed rate or code volume.

locations.quote: Priced by the claims, quoted before we start.
The work scales with how much the software says about itself, not with how much code there is.

The quote follows the size of the claim set: a small target with one short claim document is a small job; a typical business engagement, one or two documents and up to about 150 claims, is a larger one.

claims.tier_basis: The fee is in any case set at intake, so which variable the price turns on does not change what the firm would pay or when it would learn the figure; no stated threshold reaches the pricing model. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: The practice is in beta.
claims.statement: The seller's claims-review practice is currently in beta.
claims.tier_basis: No stated threshold or planned use reaches the practice's beta status; whether it is in beta changes nothing the firm pays for or relies on. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: Developers evaluating a repository of their own can write to us for access to run one; we set these up by hand for now.
claims.statement: Developers evaluating their own repository can request access to run a claims review on it; access is set up manually by the seller at present.
claims.tier_basis: The firm has said the developer beta is of no commercial interest and it will never use it again, so how beta access is set up touches nothing in its plan. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: The claims review, plus a full reading of the record and a signed opinion by a practitioner with buy-side and sell-side experience, available to your deal team through closing.
claims.statement: Attested due diligence comprises the claims review plus a full reading of the record and a signed opinion by an experienced practitioner.
claims.tier_basis: The attested tier is the only level the firm will buy, and its price assumes the claims review comes with a full reading of the record and a signed opinion; if the level did not comprise them, the firm would be paying for less than its thresholds require. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "a person's signature on the conclusion".

claims.quote: a signed opinion by a practitioner with buy-side and sell-side experience, available to your deal team through closing
claims.statement: The signed opinion is given by a practitioner with buy-side and sell-side experience, who is available to the buyer's deal team through closing.
claims.tier_basis: The signed opinion's weight with the investment committee rests on the signatory's stated buy-side and sell-side experience and on availability through closing; if either were not as described, the firm would revisit the price before committing to the further five deals a year. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "a person's signature on the conclusion".

claims.quote: The fee is set at intake.
claims.statement: The fee for attested due diligence is set at intake.
claims.tier_basis: The firm's price basis and its $30,000-a-year budget assume the fee is fixed at intake; if the fee were set some other way, the terms the firm budgeted against would change and it would renegotiate them. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: A conversation about what you are evaluating and, for a deal, your thresholds, held in your own time
claims.statement: Intake is a conversation about what the buyer is evaluating and, for a deal, the buyer's thresholds, held in the buyer's own time.
claims.tier_basis: The intake conversation is what carries the firm's thresholds into the rating step; if it did not cover what the firm is evaluating and its thresholds, the ratings the firm pays for would have nothing to rate against, and restating them would eat into a 10-day timetable. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "ratings made against the thresholds the firm states".

claims.quote: over a page that fills the engagement form as you talk
claims.statement: The intake page is built to fill the engagement form itself as the intake conversation proceeds.
claims.tier_basis: The firm has said it does not care how the intake page is built or how long intake takes, so long as the report arrives inside the 10 days; the claim's falsity would change nothing it relies on. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: An independent re-reading of every finding's evidence
claims.statement: The check stage includes an independent re-reading of every finding's evidence.
claims.tier_basis: An independent re-reading of every finding's evidence is the second check the firm names as one of the six things it is paying for; if it were skipped for some findings or re-used the first reader's work, the firm would be paying for a single reading. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "every finding checked a second time independently".

claims.quote: ratings against your thresholds, replicated and looked at again where they differ
claims.statement: Ratings are made against the buyer's thresholds, are replicated, and are looked at again where the replications differ.
claims.tier_basis: Ratings made against the firm's own thresholds are what make the materiality judgements meaningful to its investment committee; if the ratings did not use them, the firm could not credibly re-weight the findings itself. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "ratings made against the thresholds the firm states".

claims.quote: Findings with their citations, what was and was not examined, questions to put to the seller, and a signed conclusion if you ask for one.
claims.statement: The report includes findings with their citations, a statement of what was and was not examined, questions to put to the seller, and a signed conclusion on request.
claims.tier_basis: The report's contents are what the firm's engineer verifies and what the committee reads: citations it can open and confirm, the scope of what was and was not examined, and a signed conclusion; without them the firm could not confirm the work itself and would be taking the report on trust. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "every finding cited to a file and line that the firm's own engineer can open and confirm".

claims.quote: A private page where you can ask about any finding for the life of the decision
claims.statement: The target provides a private page on which the buyer can ask about any finding.
claims.tier_basis: The private question page is a convenience over the working record the firm chiefly pays to have kept; if it failed, the firm would fall back on the report and its own copy of the record, an irritation rather than a change to the plan. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: Every search and every file opened, kept, so any finding can be traced back to what was looked at.
claims.statement: The target logs every search performed and every file opened into a working record.
claims.tier_basis: The working record is what lets the firm answer its investment committee's questions a year later, and it cannot reconstruct a record it never held. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the working record not being kept, because the committee may ask for it a year later".

claims.quote: Running the software, load or penetration testing, a review of code quality or architecture, and legal or financial advice.
claims.statement: The service does not include running the software, load or penetration testing, a review of code quality or architecture, or legal or financial advice (heading 'What it does not include', line 61, supplies the negation).
claims.tier_basis: The firm buys nothing in these categories from the practice and covers them through other advisers, so the accuracy of the stated boundaries changes nothing in its plan. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: Materials the seller does not supply, whatever sits on a hosted service, in a private module, or on a third party's platform, are reported as unsettled rather than guessed at.
claims.statement: Materials the seller does not supply are reported as unsettled rather than guessed at, whatever sits on a hosted service, in a private module, or on a third party's platform.
claims.tier_basis: If materials the seller does not supply were guessed at rather than flagged, the report would present conjecture as findings and the firm's engineer could not tell which conclusions rest on evidence — the testing the firm is paying for. The failure defeats an item the practice reads as central to the buyer's plan. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: Intake takes about a day.
claims.statement: Intake takes about a day.
claims.tier_basis: Intake duration sits before the 10-day clock starts and its length changes nothing the firm relies on. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "it does not care how the intake page is built or how long intake takes, so long as the report arrives inside the 10 days."

claims.quote: with the report the day after
claims.statement: For a typical business engagement, the report comes the day after the review.
claims.tier_basis: The firm plans its 10-day window against the website's stated turnaround; if the report does not come when stated, the firm would need a longer exclusivity window and would go back to the seller over the timetable. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "a turnaround longer than the website states, because the exclusivity period is short."

claims.quote: Attested engagements add the time for a full reading, agreed at intake.
claims.statement: Attested engagements take longer by the time needed for a full reading, which is agreed at intake.
claims.tier_basis: The firm's engagement will be at the attested tier, so this is the turnaround provision its timetable rests on; if the time is not fixed at intake, the firm cannot plan against an exclusivity period it called short. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "a turnaround longer than the website states, because the exclusivity period is short."

claims.quote: For paid engagements the repository is examined on isolated, single-tenant hardware
claims.statement: For paid engagements, the repository is examined on isolated, single-tenant hardware.
claims.tier_basis: Where the repository is examined is the substance of the firm's condition that seller code stay on hardware Tuuyi controls on paid engagements; its falsity would put seller code on hardware no one named. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the seller's code kept on hardware Tuuyi controls".

claims.quote: the practice controls
claims.statement: That hardware is controlled by the practice (the relative clause in line 71 attaches to the isolated, single-tenant hardware).
claims.tier_basis: If the isolated hardware were not controlled by the practice, the firm's requirement that its sellers' code stay on hardware Tuuyi controls would fail, and the firm cannot repair who holds the hardware. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the seller's code kept on hardware Tuuyi controls".

claims.quote: in an environment created for the engagement
claims.statement: The target has a provisioning process that stands up an examination environment for an engagement.
claims.tier_basis: If no examination environment is stood up per engagement, one seller's code could persist into another deal — a failure the firm named as grounds to end the engagement and cannot repair after the fact. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: deleted afterwards
claims.statement: The target has a teardown process that removes the examination environment when an engagement ends.
claims.tier_basis: If the environment is not removed when an engagement ends, one seller's code could survive into a later engagement, which the firm cannot repair and would treat as a walk-away. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: None of the seller's code is sent to any cloud model service
claims.statement: None of the seller's code is sent to any cloud model service.
claims.tier_basis: The firm made this a condition that ends the deal outright, and its non-disclosure obligations to sellers leave no repair once code has reached a model service. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "any of a seller's code reaching a cloud model service or any party other than Tuuyi on a paid engagement".

claims.quote: Your deal terms are held in the engagement file
claims.statement: The buyer's deal terms are held in the engagement file.
claims.tier_basis: The firm stated that its deal terms must be held only in the engagement file and made any other storage a condition ending the engagement. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the firm's deal terms being stored anywhere other than the engagement file".

claims.quote: nowhere else
claims.statement: The buyer's deal terms are held nowhere else (the boundary in line 71, 'and nowhere else').
claims.tier_basis: The boundary is what makes the engagement-file promise complete; if the deal terms are held elsewhere, the firm's end-the-deal condition is met and no repair is possible on Tuuyi's side. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the firm's deal terms being stored anywhere other than the engagement file".

claims.quote: A free beta review is the exception: it runs on a hosted model.
claims.statement: The target's beta path is configured to run free beta reviews on a hosted model.
claims.tier_basis: The beta path never touches the firm's paid engagements, so its configuration changes nothing the firm relies on. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the free demo and the developer beta are of no commercial interest to the firm, and that it will never use them again".

claims.quote: Terms, retention and the limitation of liability are set out in the engagement letter.
claims.statement: The terms, retention and limitation of liability are set out in the engagement letter.
claims.tier_basis: If the engagement letter does not govern as described, the firm must settle terms before the first review — doable before paying, and cheap at this stage — so no price or term would change over this claim alone. The document is not itself the fact the firm relies on; the terms can still be agreed. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: over a page that fills the engagement form as you talk
claims.statement: During an intake conversation, the engagement form is filled in by the page as the conversation happens.
claims.tier_basis: How the intake form is filled changes nothing about the report the firm receives. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "it does not care how the intake page is built or how long intake takes, so long as the report arrives inside the 10 days".

claims.quote: A private page where you can ask about any finding for the life of the decision
claims.statement: That private page remains available to the buyer for the life of the decision.
claims.tier_basis: The firm chiefly pays for the working record it can hold itself; losing the question page would be an irritation answered from the record, not a change to price or terms. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: with the record behind each answer
claims.statement: Each answer the buyer receives on that page actually comes with the record behind it.
claims.tier_basis: If answers on the private question page did not come with the record behind them, the firm would fall back on the report and its own copy of the working record, which the reliance statement treats as an irritation rather than a failure; no stated threshold names the question page. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: Every search and every file opened, kept, so any finding can be traced back to what was looked at.
claims.statement: The working record is kept, so that any finding can be traced back to the searches and files that were looked at for it.
claims.tier_basis: The working record is one of the six things the firm is paying for: it depends on it outright, and its falsity would leave the firm unable to answer its investment committee's questions a year later, with nothing to reconstruct the record from. That is a failure the firm said would change the price or terms, and it would go back to the seller over it alone. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the working record not being kept, because the committee may ask for it a year later".

claims.quote: in an environment created for the engagement
claims.statement: For each paid engagement, a fresh examination environment is in fact created for that engagement.
claims.tier_basis: If no fresh environment were created per paid engagement, one seller's code could survive into another engagement, which the firm stated as a condition that would end the deal outright and cannot repair on Tuuyi's side. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: deleted afterwards
claims.statement: The examination environment is in fact deleted after the engagement.
claims.tier_basis: If the examination environment were not deleted after the engagement, prior sellers' code would persist on Tuuyi's hardware, which the firm stated as a condition that would end the deal outright and cannot repair on Tuuyi's side. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: A free beta review is the exception: it runs on a hosted model.
claims.statement: A free beta review actually runs on a hosted model when it is performed.
claims.tier_basis: The free beta review is outside the engagement: the firm will never use the demo or the beta, and the hosted model touches none of its paid engagements, so the walk-away condition about code reaching a cloud model service — which is limited to paid engagements — does not reach it. Rated on the scale alone.
